role: District Representative · Iligan City, Lone District
summary: Iligan City representative with 138 principal-authored bills. Authored a requirement for an Act of Congress before privatization of the Agus Pulangi hydroelectric plant, an estate tax amnesty extension and a PERA increase for government employees to 7,000. Also authored a regional medical center, a Hall of Justice and a medical college in Iligan.
caveat: Only three economic bills; many other bills are local facilities.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored an Act-of-Congress requirement before privatizing the Agus Pulangi hydro plant (-3) and a PERA increase for government employees (-1), against an estate tax amnesty extension (+2).
